topics.headline: US CPI rebound likely, but Eurozone HICP direction is the swing factor
topics.summary: Analysts expect US July CPI to tick up on energy base effects, but Eurozone HICP has been decelerating sharply (3.2%→2.8%) with broad-based disinflation across member states, making a simultaneous rise in both unlikely; the joint "yes" hinges on an unexpected Eurozone uptick at the July 31 flash estimate.

topics.headline: HY spreads near historic tights at 2.68%, bias skews toward widening
topics.summary: At 2.68%, spreads sit in the tightest 5% of readings since 2000, and strategists (State Street, Janus Henderson, LPL) argue the statistical and fundamental odds favor eventual widening, though most concede timing is uncertain and spreads can grind sideways for extended periods; no near-term catalyst (FOMC July 29 expected to hold) points to a clear 30-day trigger.

topics.headline: BTC ETFs post $225M outflow, snapping seven-day inflow streak
topics.summary: After nearly $1B in inflows over seven days, spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $225.2M leave on July 24 while Ether ETFs kept extending gains; Citi cut its 12-month inflow forecast to zero, and analysts say a single choppy week isn't enough to confirm sustained institutional demand returning.

topics.headline: VIX spikes near 19 amid FOMC, tariffs, and Iran risk
topics.summary: VIX jumped 12% to 18.70 (trailing 3-month avg ~17), driven by looming Trump tariffs, a July 29 FOMC decision, and Middle East oil-price fears; but with contango historically dominant and vol prone to mean-revert once catalysts pass, the setup is genuinely two-sided for the 30-day window.

topics.headline: Microsoft-Chevron 2GW PPA confirms near-monthly hyperscaler power deal pace
topics.summary: Microsoft's July 2 20-year deal with Chevron subsidiary Energy Forge One for 2GW in Pecos, Texas is the latest concrete example of a pattern that's now recurring almost weekly, alongside Brookfield-Bloom's $25B initiative and continued nuclear-adjacent tie-ups (Terrestrial-Riot, GE Vernova-Blue Energy), strongly suggesting another such announcement within 30 days is highly likely.
